decision: Selected the centroid of the statewide-parcel polygon whose situs is 100 Italy Dr in Storey County, the facility address that Colovore Reno 1 LLC gave on its GOED incentive application, as the campus locator for RNO01. The building positions inside the parcel are not published.

selected_properties.OwnerName_2018: STORMO PROPERTIES LLC (a company; not used as a current owner role)

computed.method: Polygon ring returned with outSR=4326 (native EPSG:26911); centroid computed in EPSG:32611 and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: Colovore release (9 September 2026): the first data center on the RNO01 campus in Sparks, Nevada (Reno metro) has officially opened; a second data center is under construction on the same campus.
Storey County notice of a possible quorum (posted on or before 4 September 2026): Colovore Data Center ribbon cutting, 9 September 2026, at Colovore Data Center, 100 Italy Dr., McCarran, NV 89437.

GOED board packet for Colovore Reno 1 LLC (summary page dated 5 August 2026): proposed facility address 100 Italy Drive, McCarran, Storey County 89437; the application says the project is the company's first Nevada data-centre presence, and the company timeline in the packet names RNO01 as its first Reno site (16 MW).
Colovore Reno market page (undated, captured 22 October 2026): RNO01 is in Sparks, NV, 16 MW in two 8 MW halls, sold out; RNO02 is a separate Reno site.

Statewide parcel layer: situs 100 ITALY DR, Storey County, APN 509110, 7.73 acres, in the Tahoe-Reno Industrial (TRI) general improvement district, whose mailing addresses are given as McCarran or Sparks.

consistency_checks.vintage: The statewide layer is the Nevada Division of State Lands compilation dated 2018-12-31 with SourceDate 2018-07-09 for Storey County; the parcel may since have been re-platted. A current Storey County parcel could not be retrieved: the county's assessor parcel pages (storeynv.devnetwedge.com/parcel/*) are disallowed by robots.txt, the county publishes only PDF assessor maps, and the 2024 statewide copy on arcgis.water.nv.gov is restricted from redistribution under NRS 250.
consistency_checks.situs_match: exact street-number and street-name match to the application address
